title: Implement sACN Universe Discovery dissection
description:
Implements the dissector for the sACN Universe Discovery protocol exension
following existing patterns from the ACN/RDMnet dissector

Closes #18755

notes.body: Will fix CI and update PR

added 2 commits
  • 0027897c - Fix CI issues - blurb matches description
  • e0a92dc8 - Fix CI: data_length may be uninitialized in some cases
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9229/diffs?diff_id=565999471&start_sha=efe872c40a623def80a0600a49b06b1e8c62be3b)
it is always better to display reserved bytes

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9229/diffs?diff_id=566406551&start_sha=e0a92dc805dce2843fe4f1063cf1c4e456b62408#74c2bbc67aa500ca891886f030161179643ea596_5793_5795)
Why use snprintf ? it is not possible to use proto_tree_add_item ?

I was following the previous pattern in `dissect_acn_dmx_data_pdu()` -- it is possible that the list could be several hundred integers before it is split into multiple packets. I believe this is trying to aid in readability -- the dmx_data version of this is normally printing 512 8-bit integers, while this is a variable list of 16-bit integers.

If you feel strongly, I could do the strings differently (I'm still very new to Wireshark best practices), but I would still need to show multiple values per row. It will be difficult to read a lengthy list one by one if there's hundreds of values.
Universe List ?

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9229/diffs?diff_id=566406551&start_sha=e0a92dc805dce2843fe4f1063cf1c4e456b62408#74c2bbc67aa500ca891886f030161179643ea596_8021_8024)
you can remove "comment" (DMX Extension Vector), it is the same like name (Vector)

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9229/diffs?diff_id=566406551&start_sha=e0a92dc805dce2843fe4f1063cf1c4e456b62408#74c2bbc67aa500ca891886f030161179643ea596_8013_8016)
can you squash change ?
I updated the PR settings to squash when the PR is accepted -- if I need to do something else, just let me know.
